## Checklist

- [ ] `mise run check` passes (tests, types, lint, format, docs).
- [ ] A change to what Cockpit draws is checked in a live session at 200 and 100 columns (`tools/live`).
- [ ] The spec (`docs/design/cockpit.md` or `statusline.md`) says what the change makes true.
- [ ] Screenshots or captures attached for anything a user sees.
- [ ] The PR title is a conventional commit written for the changelog.
